available.title: Available Review Tasks
available.caption: Tasks waiting to be picked up
available.emptyHint: Tasks appear here once a developer submits them. Your own submissions never appear.
available.picked: {taskCode} is yours. It is now In Review.
available.lostRace: Someone else picked this up first.

assigned.title: My Review Tasks
assigned.caption: Tasks you are currently reviewing
assigned.emptyHint: Pick a task from the Available queue to start reviewing.

history.title: Review History
history.caption: Reviews you have completed
history.emptyHint: Reviews you approve or send back appear here.

form.title: Code Review Form
form.subtitle: Complete the review form below before making your decision.
form.handoverSubtitle: Return this review task for reassignment.
form.handoverDescription: {taskCode} returns to Available Tasks and the admin handover queue. Your answers so far are kept, but the task leaves your list until it is picked or reassigned.
form.handoverReasonHint: The admin sees this when deciding who picks it up.
form.handoverReasonHelper: This reason will be visible to Admin during reassignment.
form.handoverReasonPlaceholder: e.g. On leave from Friday — needs someone with Lobby experience.
form.handoverSuccess: {taskCode} handed back to the admin queue.
form.handoverPoint1: Your current draft and review comments will be preserved.
form.handoverPoint2: The task will leave your active review list.
form.handoverPoint3: Admin will decide whether to reassign it or return it to the reviewer queue.
form.handoverReassurance: Handing over does not approve, reject, or change the review cycle.
form.developerAttachmentsHint: Supporting images the developer attached with this submission.
form.findingsIncorrectPlaceholder: Describe any incorrect code, bugs, or performance issues found…
form.findingsIncompletePlaceholder: Describe any incomplete features or missing functionality…
form.findingsFormatting: Source Code Formatting, Naming, Comments, Indentation and Readability
form.findingsFormattingPlaceholder: Describe any issues with code style, naming conventions, comments, or readability…
form.feedbackSummaryHint: Brief summary visible in feedback history.
form.feedbackSummaryPlaceholder: Provide a brief summary of your review…
form.rank1Description: Review did not show up any serious issues. Development can be delivered after functional testing.
form.rank2Description: Review showed up minor issues that need to be fixed before delivering the CRIM to customer. A re-review must be done prior to delivery.
form.rank3Description: Review showed up at least one serious issue that requires a significant implementation change. A re-review must be done prior to delivering the CRIM to customer.
form.screenshotsHint: Upload screenshots to visually highlight issues found during the review. Add feedback comments for each screenshot.

blockers.title: Before you can submit this review
blockers.findingsRequired: Describe the issues in Detailed Review Findings
blockers.approveBlockedByRank: Approve is not available at Rank 2 or Rank 3 — request changes instead

screenshotRejected.wrongType: {fileName} is not a PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP image.
screenshotRejected.tooMany: You can attach at most 10 screenshots.

rejections.title: Developer Rejections Review
rejections.subtitle: The developer rejected one or more findings from the previous review round. Evaluate each justification.
rejections.allAcceptedBanner: All developer rejections have been accepted. You can now approve this task with the cycle count reduced by 1.
rejections.singleAcceptedBanner: The developer rejection has been accepted. You can now approve this task with the cycle count reduced by 1.

sidebar.readinessSubtitle: Validation status of the current review form
sidebar.notificationBody: When you Approve or Request Changes, the developer will receive an email notification with a direct link to inspect the review findings.

form.historySubtitle: Every completed round on this task, newest first.
form.noScreenshotsHint: No screenshot feedback has been attached to this task.
form.emptyCommentsApprovedHint: All quality requirements were met during this round. No review comments were recorded.
